basis: NN’s October 30 results release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated GAAP table reports net sales of $113,587,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2024, versus $124,443,000 a year earlier. That was an 8.72% decline, below the $118,220,850 ceiling. The reported comparison includes Lubbock sales in the prior-year base. NN separately calculated a 0.5% decline after excluding the divestiture and other effects.

coverage.detail: May 6, preceding earnings cycle. NN gave a $485 million to $505 million revenue range for full-year 2024. The May 7 call also described the sales outlook in annual terms. Neither supplied a Q3 consolidated sales ceiling.
The June Sidoti investor presentation discussed the 2024 outlook by end market. It gave no bounded Q3 consolidated net-sales forecast.
July 2, Lubbock plastics plant sale announcement. NN reduced its full-year revenue range to $465 million to $485 million. The release did not allocate the reduction to Q3.

August 7, immediately preceding earnings release. NN reaffirmed the July full-year range. Subtracting reported first-half sales of $244.190 million implies $220.810 million to $240.810 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. That arithmetic leaves Q3’s upper bound undetermined.
Slide 14 of the Q2 earnings presentation repeats the $465 million to $485 million full-year sales range. Its Q3 completion target concerns refinancing.

August 8, public Q2 call. Management reiterated the annual sales range. The specific third-quarter financial comment concerned depreciation rolling off. The call supplied no numeric Q3 consolidated sales ceiling.
The August 30 interim 8-K disclosed amendments to NN’s term loan and asset-based credit agreement. It supplied no quarterly sales update.
October 17. NN scheduled the Q3 results release for October 31 after market close. The notice contained no preliminary sales figure.
October 23. NN moved publication forward to October 30 after market close and scheduled the call for October 31. This notice also contained no preliminary sales figure.
Item 2.02 confirms NN issued the Q3 results release on October 30. Item 7.01 confirms NN posted the supplemental presentation that day for the following morning’s call.

publication_date_evidence: NN’s investor-relations results page is timestamped October 30, 2024 at 6:00 PM EDT. Its dateline and Form 8-K Item 2.02 independently identify October 30 as the release date. The 10-Q filing and earnings call followed on October 31.
